claims.text: For every merged change, seamkit reads production back for the deployable units you declared and gives a verdict that lists what it did not examine and never passes when it examined nothing. The judgement replays byte for byte from the observations recorded in your own git.
provenBy: packages/core/src/core.test.ts#refuses a pass that examined nothing (zero rows is never a pass)
packages/core/src/core.test.ts#combines nothing into examined_nothing, unlike the vacuous truth of [].every
packages/core/src/core.test.ts#keeps every gap and reason, prefixed by the part that produced it
packages/core/src/readback.test.ts#is examined nothing over no changes, never a pass
packages/core/src/readback.test.ts#examines nothing when production does not say what it runs
